gate: Some people are wired to feel the gap between themselves and the ones they care about, and to feel it as a pull in the body, not as a thought. This is that wiring. It is the quiet, ongoing insistence that survival actually happens in closeness, in tribe, in the small circle of people who matter, and never alone. The sensitivity runs ahead of thought. It picks up what someone in the room needs before that person has said a word, and it moves to approach, to bring near, to make sure no one goes cold or unfed. The misread is to call this neediness, as if the wanting itself were a flaw. The wanting is not the flaw. It is the code doing its job, registering where closeness is missing and reaching to close the distance. What goes wrong is when the sensitivity hardens into obligation, when the approach becomes compulsive caretaking and the body forgets it has its own hungers to bring into the room.
centre_field: This wanting lives in the part of you that runs survival from the floor of the body, the part that pulses pressure up through everything else and decides when it is time to move and when it is time to wait. The placement is the whole teaching. Wanting here is not a soft emotion. It is a survival drive, a root-level urgency that something must be reached for and brought near, or the circle will go thin. That part of you does not run steady. It pulses on, then off, then on again, and the sensitivity inherits the rhythm. There are stretches of acute longing followed by stretches where the wanting quiets and the body simply waits. The misread is to treat the pulse as a personal failing, to push when the pressure has lifted or numb out when it surges. The teaching is timing. Feel the want, sit inside its pressure, move only when the current actually arrives.
channel: A pull alone does not finish the work. The reaching toward closeness registers the gap, but registering is not the same as knowing what to do once someone is near. A sensitivity with no shape to give it will draw anyone close, then have no language for when the closeness goes wrong, no way to tell a true bond from a false one. What this code reaches for is the other half: a felt sense of principles, the inner knowing that some bonds nourish and some have curdled, and the willingness to say so. The reaching gives the principles someone to apply themselves to. The principles give the sensitivity teeth. The lineage calls this connection the channel of synthesis, the current that decides who is fed and held and who is gently let go. Joined, the wanting stops being longing and becomes a person who can keep a circle real.
